Q5738.reason: The laptop is the main purpose of the deal, so the UCC governs unless the service agreement is shown to be the predominant purpose, though the higher service price makes this close.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and the defendant formed the intent to steal only after he was already inside.

Q8324.reason: Agitation with urgent drug-seeking points to withdrawal or craving, which fits reduced dopamine release into the synaptic cleft, though the presentation is nonspecific.
